name: Momoko-chan for Me R Gaiden ~Yubiwa ni Kometa Omoi~
original_name: ももこちゃんfor Me R 外伝 ～指輪にこめた想い～
source:
Main character is a doctor who finally decides to propose to his assistant nurse Momoko. He buys a ring, but it disappears. He gets upset, but starts to think that maybe it's a sign not to get bonded with just one person.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-august-2002-ever17-out-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
身为医生的主人公终于决定向担任护士助手的桃子求婚。他买好戒指，戒指却不翼而飞。主人公十分沮丧，转念又想：也许这是一种暗示，告诉自己不该只与一个人缔结关系。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-august-2002-ever17-out-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
